answer: Bayesian Truth Serum peer-prediction stops Sybil herding without needing an external oracle: each agent auditing a saffron batch submits both a primary verdict and a forecast of the peer vote distribution across the consensus lagoon. Payouts reward verdicts that are surprisingly common relative to the geometric mean of peer predictions. A ring of sable clones parroting an unverified script makes its choice predictably expected rather than surprisingly common, scoring negative information rent and forfeiting each clone's bond.
